title: Multivac celebrates its 50th anniversary
content: # Multivac celebrates its 50th anniversary. From a small business to a global market leader: Multivac celebrates its 50th anniversary. Multivac celebrates its 50th anniversary this year. The company was founded in 1961 by Sepp Haggenmüller in Böhen in the Allgäu and has since developed into a leading global full-range supplier of packaging solutions for food, sterile medical products and various industrial goods. Today the Multivac Group has more than 3,000 employees worldwide, including over 1,300 at its headquarters in Wolfertschwenden (Allgäu). It all began with the first Multivac chamber machine which Sepp Haggenmüller built in 1961. From the seventies onwards, the machine manufacturer from Allgäu began to develop his machine designs with groundbreaking innovations in the direction of resources conservation, hygienic design and consumer protection, which was pioneering at the time. Today more than half of the thermoforming packaging machines worldwide come from the machine manufacturer from Allgäu. In the early nineties, the traysealer was added to the chamber machine and thermoforming packaging machine ranges as the third product group.

title: About us - Multivac
content: ### MULTIVAC - Packaging and processing solutions designed and built for your success. Packaging machines & packaging technology, automation solutions & processing technology, labelling and inspection systems, portioning and slicing - and, since the takeover of the FRITSCH Group, bakery technology as well. Company headquarters - as well as the nucleus of the now global MULTIVAC Group - are located in Wolfertschwenden, Germany. 16 production sites, state-of-the-art Application Centers, best-in-class service and support, comprehensive advice and intelligent logistics ensure that all MULTIVAC solutions are successfully deployed worldwide. Founded in 1961 in a small garage in Böhen and now firmly rooted in the idyllic German region of Allgäu, our group of companies has quickly developed into a global player and a trusted provider of integrated solutions. sales and service companies are part of the MULTIVAC Group. More than 1,000 sales advisors and service technicians worldwide dedicate their know-how and experience to the benefit of our customers.

title: MULTIVAC Marks 50 Years In Business - Bakers Journal
content: Since it was founded by Sepp Haggenmüller in 1961, MULTIVAC has developed into a full-range supplier of automated packaging solutions. Haggenmüller built the first MULTIVAC chamber machine in 1961. In 1966 and 1967, the first thermoforming machines followed, marking an international breakthrough for Haggenmüller and his partners. In the early nineties, the tray sealer was added to MULTIVAC’s packaging machine ranges, making it possible to seal pre-fabricated trays and tubs. In addition to packaging machines, handling solutions for loading and unloading as well as the separation of packets, quality inspection systems for detecting quality faults and foreign objects in the packs are now part of the machine manufacturer's portfolio. MULTIVAC also developed solutions for complete line control and for fully documenting the packaging procedure. The MULTIVAC Group has more than 3,000 employees worldwide, including over 1,300 at its headquarters in Wolfertschwenden. The MULTIVAC group of companies has a worldwide sales and service network of more than 60 wholly owned subsidiaries. Founded by the Government of Canada.
